Title: Create new loyalty program (Order loyalty)
Preconditions: Admin user logged in with loyalty:access permission; Loyalty module accessible at #!/workspace/loyalty; no program named 'AGENT-TEST-Order-Program' exists. NOTE (live 2026-09-17, platform 3.1071.0): Save requires Name + Store + at least one condition + at least one reward; the earlier four-field version of this case could never save.
Steps:
[NAV] {{BACK_URL}}/#!/workspace/loyalty
[BLADE] 'Loyalty programs' list blade is visible
[ACT] capture the program row count on the 'Loyalty programs' blade badge
[ACT] click 'Add' button in the toolbar
[WAIT] 'Add loyalty program' type-selector blade opens
[ACT] click the 'Order loyalty' type
[WAIT] 'New loyalty program' detail blade opens
[ACT] fill 'Name': 'AGENT-TEST-Order-Program'
[ACT] select 'Store': @td(STORE_PRIMARY.id) from the Store dropdown
[ACT] fill 'Priority': 1
[ACT] toggle 'Active' to ON
[ACT] click 'Add condition' under the conditions header
[WAIT] the 3-group condition menu renders already expanded
[ACT] click the 'Order status is...' row under 'Order conditions'
[WAIT] the condition row is appended
[ACT] click 'Add reward' under the rewards header
[WAIT] the two-item reward-type menu is visible
[ACT] click 'Earn fixed amount of points per order'
[WAIT] the reward row is appended with its points input
[ACT] fill the reward points input: 5
[SAVE] click 'Save' in the toolbar
[WAIT] the save round-trip completes — the blade title changes to the program name
[ACT] close the detail blade
[WAIT] 'Loyalty programs' list blade regains focus
[ACT] click 'Refresh' in the toolbar
[WAIT] the 'Loyalty programs' grid has reloaded
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no JS errors during save
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on the save request
Failure_Signals: Save stays disabled after a condition AND a reward are added; program absent from the grid after Refresh; badge count unchanged; 4xx/5xx on the save request
Cleanup: Delete 'AGENT-TEST-Order-Program' via the row kebab menu (the toolbar Delete button does not enable — see LOY-004) and confirm with 'Yes'
